name: @shres-code/shres-code-desktop
description: Electron desktop shell for a bundled shres runtime and external plugins
author: Shres Code contributors

scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:packages && pnpm run prepare:runtime-tree && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --publish never
scripts.package:dir: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:packages && pnpm run prepare:runtime-tree && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.mjs --publish never
